title: What the Tide Kept

texts.details:
If the elves lived here, even for a few years, they left things behind. Cups, combs, the small things people leave when they go in a hurry.

The fishermen used to say that the murlocs on the north shore hoard old silver in their huts, and that it was never ours. A murloc will pick up anything that shines and keep it for ever.

Bring me what they have, $N. Four pieces would be enough to be sure.
texts.objectives: Bring 4 Elven Cup Relics from the Vile Fin murlocs of the north coast to Claire Willower in Brill.
texts.progress: The Vile Fin keep to the north shore, from the lake's mouth east along the coast.
texts.completion:
Elven work. Look at the leaf along the rim, and the script under it. Plainer than what the traders used to bring down from Quel'Thalas, and far older. Made by people who had just crossed an ocean.

So that much is true. They were here, and they left in a hurry.

What they feared under this ground was never found. It was never shown to be nothing, either. I do not guess, $N. I keep records. I have written down that they were here, and why they said they went.

idea: Chain 2 of 2: a keepsake of the elves' first settlement, and that what they feared beneath Tirisfal was never proven.
